Definition: Tsochar, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Zohar = "tawny"; 1) a Judaite, son of Ashur by wife Helah; 2) father of Ephron the Hittite; 3) one of the sons of Simeon; also 'Zerah'
